mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, org_id, people_id, task_type, biz_key, open_dedup_key, status, priority, assignee_staff_id, title, summary, payload_json, source, close_reason, due_at, opened_at, done_at, done_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_task( id, tenant_id, org_id, people_id, task_type, biz_key, status, priority, assignee_staff_id, title, summary, payload_json, source, close_reason, due_at, opened_at, done_at, done_by_staff_id, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{orgId}, #{peopleId}, #{taskType}, #{bizKey}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{assigneeStaffId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{payloadJson}, #{source}, #{closeReason}, #{dueAt}, #{openedAt}, #{doneAt}, #{doneByStaffId}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_task SET summary = #{summary}, payload_json = #{payloadJson}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE workspace_task SET assignee_staff_id = #{staffId}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND assignee_staff_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE workspace_task SET status = #{status}, close_reason = #{closeReason}, done_at = #{doneAt}, done_by_staff_id = #{doneByStaffId}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE workspace_task t LEFT JOIN people_org_membership m ON m.org_id = t.org_id AND m.people_id = t.people_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' SET t.status = 'EXPIRED', t.close_reason = 'EXPIRED', t.done_at = #{now}, t.gmt_modified = #{now} WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.status = 'OPEN' AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND m.pk_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM workspace_task WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT FROM workspace_task WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND task_type = 'PLAN_NUDGE' AND status IN ('DONE', 'CANCELLED') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY done_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM workspace_task WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND people_id = #{peopleId} AND task_type = 'METRIC_ALERT' AND biz_key LIKE CONCAT(#{bizKeyPrefix}, '%') AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT t.pk_id, t.id, t.tenant_id, t.org_id, t.people_id, t.task_type, t.biz_key, t.open_dedup_key, t.status, t.priority, t.assignee_staff_id, t.title, t.summary, t.payload_json, t.source, t.close_reason, t.due_at, t.opened_at, t.done_at, t.done_by_staff_id, t.is_deleted, t.gmt_created, t.gmt_modified, t.gmt_deleted
ORDER BY t.done_at DESC, t.id DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'OPEN' AND t.due_at IS NOT NULL AND t.due_at < NOW() THEN 0 WHEN t.status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, CASE WHEN t.status = 'OPEN' THEN IFNULL(t.due_at, '9999-12-31 23:59:59') ELSE NULL END ASC, t.opened_at DESC, t.id DESC
ORDER BY t.opened_at DESC, t.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
